highlights: Log many: tap Log by voice and say, for example, water all bag area, or fed all pasture in ground except zephyr. The app shows the plants it will log, with the skipped ones unticked, and logs them only when you say next or tap to confirm.
Today's watering list now always shows the 20 longest-waiting plants in each group, with a Show more button. Each group header still shows the true count, and Log all watering still logs every plant.
Put-Up: when a ferment has gone a week from a start date you gave to the day, with no pH reading since, its card asks: It's been a week, has the pH come down yet?
More, Debug and smoke now shows your phone's real screen width (Viewport).
